data.notes: April 2027 is centered on Spring Blanc-style mountain music: high-altitude concerts, DJ sunset sessions, and ski-area live-music formats, with some headline artists still to be announced.

events.title: Top of the Mountain Spring Concert
events.summary: Ischgl’s Spring Blanc concert series returns to the Ischgl Stage at 2,300 metres for a top-class open-air concert; the artist lineup is still marked as coming soon.

events.title: 37th International Spring Snow Festival
events.summary: The 37th International Spring Snow Festival brings top-class musical entertainment to Alp Trida in the connected Samnaun/Ischgl ski area; the headliner has not yet been announced.

events.title: sun.downer Ischgl
events.summary: A limited-capacity sunset session at 2,624 metres with chill DJ sounds, an outdoor lounge, ice bar and grill from 19:00 to 21:00.

events.title: sun.downer Ischgl
events.summary: The second April 2027 sun.downer date pairs the Pardatschgrat sunset with chill DJ sounds, an outdoor lounge, ice bar and grill from 19:00 to 21:00.

events.title: Hüttenrallye See
events.summary: A hut-to-hut live-music day in the nearby See ski area, with three bands scheduled across Gratli, Ascherhütte and Medrig Alm; specific music groups are still listed as forthcoming.

events.title: Lodge Rally: 3 Bands 3 Lodges
events.summary: A piste-to-piste live-music rally in See, Paznaun, with three bands performing across three mountain lodges. The official listing names Oidhoiz for the finale at Medrig Alm and states admission is free with a valid ski ticket.
